mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above 12-month moving averages fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annualized), rising GDP growth signals continued economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 800.0 (thousands of units) signals weak consumer demand for durable goods, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI inflation rate above 2.0% annualized signals accelerating price pressures that trigger monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 135 million signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer income and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 135 million.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production index above 98.0 signals expanding manufacturing output that increases corporate production capacity, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 98.0.
